item: merge.py: every write names main., a scan test keeps it so, and the CI floor-leg pin is tied to the pytest step
summary: The 65 remaining unqualified INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP TRIGGER statements in merge.py now name main., so a corpus missing a table fails loudly instead of the write falling through to the attached backup. tests/test_merge_writes_name_main.py reads the SQL the module can send (string constants, and the statement of execute/executemany/executescript and of the helpers that hand a parameter on, by position or keyword, built by f-string, concatenation, % or .format, through text() and conditionals), fails on a write that names neither main. nor temp. (and on an unqualified ANALYZE or PRAGMA optimize) and on a statement it cannot read, with a 5-entry reasoned allowlist whose dead entries fail, planted cases per shape, and a behavioural case (merge_batches dropped from the live corpus: the merge fails, the incoming file is byte-identical). fts._index_rows, which the merge calls with the backup attached, names main. too. The #1392 CHECK-2 nits: the floor-leg pin now requires the export in the env mapping of every step that runs pytest (the workflow parsed as YAML). fts.rebuild_index names main. too.
